entities.summary: Caleb Khristopher Love is an American professional basketball player for the Portland Trail Blazers of the National Basketball Association (NBA), on a two-way contract with the Rip City Remix of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the North Carolina Tar Heels and the Arizona Wildcats.
